page.title: Zolumikizira
page.intro: Lumikizani maakaunti anu otsatsa. Zotsogola zochokera pazotsatsa zanu zimangofika mu My Leads, ndi ndalama komanso mtengo wotsogolera.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form imatsogolera ku Matsogolero Anga, ndalama zatsiku ndi tsiku ndi mtengo wotsogola, ndi khalidwe lotsogola lotumizidwa ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn yolumikizidwa. Zotsogola zikulandidwa tsopano - tsambali likusintha posachedwa.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn sinakhazikitsidwe pa seva iyi panobe. Woyang'anira akuyenera kuwonjezera ID ya kasitomala ya pulogalamu ya LinkedIn komanso chinsinsi.
banner.expired: Kulumikizana kwa LinkedIn kwatha, chifukwa chake zotsogolera sizikulumikizana. Lumikizaninso kuti mupitilize.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn ikufuna kuti mulowenso pa {{date}} . Lumikizaninso isanakwane kuti mayendedwe aziyenda.

connect.title: Lumikizani LinkedIn
connect.intro: Lowani ndi akaunti LinkedIn yomwe imayendetsa zotsatsa zanu. Leadrat amangowerenga maakaunti anu otsatsa, otsogolera Lead Gen Form ndi ziwerengero zotsatsa, ndikutumiza zosintha zomwe mumayatsa.
connect.need1: Udindo pa LinkedIn ad account (Wowonera kapena apamwamba).
connect.need2: Ntchito pa tsamba la kampani yolumikizidwa (Woyang'anira, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator kapena Analyst) - LinkedIn imafuna kuti igawane zitsogozo.
connect.need3: Funso la nambala yafoni pa Lead Gen Forms - otsogolera opanda nambala yafoni sangathe kuwonjezedwa.

connection.title: Kulumikizana
connection.syncResult: Kulunzanitsa kwachitika: {{received}} kulandiridwa, {{created}} kudapangidwa, {{duplicates}} kubwereza, {{rejected}} kukanidwa.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Chotsani LinkedIn ? Kuyanjanitsa kuyimitsidwa ndipo zizindikiro zolowera zimachotsedwa. Zotsogolera, ziwerengero ndi chipika cha zochitika zimasungidwa.
connection.noPermission: Mutha kuwona tsambali. Kulumikiza ndikusintha zokonda kumafunika chilolezo cha "Manage Settings".
connection.fetchHint: Zotsogola zatsopano zimawunikiridwa mphindi zingapo zilizonse ndipo masiku 7 omaliza amawunikidwanso tsiku lililonse, kuti palibe chomwe chimaphonya. Gwiritsani ntchito izi pazowongolera musanalumikizidwe, kapena kuti muwonenso nthawi (mpaka masiku 90 nthawi imodzi). Zotsogola zomwe zili kale ku Leadrat zalumphidwa.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} kwapezeka, {{created}} kudapangidwa, {{duplicates}} kubwereza, {{rejected}} kukanidwa, {{skipped}} kutumizidwa kale.

accounts.title: Maakaunti otsatsa
accounts.intro: Zotsogola ndi ziwerengero zimalumikizidwa kuchokera kumaakaunti otsatsa omwe amayatsidwa pano.
accounts.none: Palibe maakaunti otsatsa omwe apezeka paakaunti iyi LinkedIn . Onani ntchito ya akaunti mu LinkedIn Campaign Manager , kenako yambitsaninso.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Uzani LinkedIn kuti ndi ati omwe adatsogolera omwe adakhala chiyembekezo chenicheni. Mtsogoleri wa LinkedIn akafika pamalo omwe mwasankha pansipa, Leadrat amauza LinkedIn , kotero kuti malipoti anu a kampeni amawonetsa khalidwe lotsogola ndipo LinkedIn ikhoza kupeza anthu ambiri ngati otsogolera anu abwino. ID chotsogolera cha LinkedIn ndi njira imodzi yokha ya imelo ndizotumizidwa.

activity.title: Lolemba zochita
activity.intro: Chilichonse pakati pa Leadrat ndi LinkedIn : kulumikizana, kulunzanitsa kulikonse, chitsogozo chilichonse ndi zomwe zidachitika, kutembenuka ndi zolakwika.
